response.original_title: Tears For Fears: Songs From The Big Chair
response.overview: The 4-CD/2-DVD box set for Songs From the Big Chair was released November 3, 2014 in the UK and a day later in the US. It followed a similar deluxe treatment given to The Hurting the previous year. The DVD includes the original vintage "Songs from the Big Chair" documentary, a 2005 interview with producer Chris Hughes, all the promotional videos from the album, and eight BBC-TV performances (from shows like Top of the Pops and Wogan).
